requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area. The 18-guest capacity is not converted into an area threshold, and the energy class and healthcare proximity are not in the reference columns.

Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested. Classes A1-A4, B, C and D are included; E, F and G are excluded. energy_score_class is not used because it groups D with E (both score 3) and cannot isolate D or better.
